measurement.scope: real auto-tagger handler; one simulated CloudTrail creation event per timed call
measurement.aws_api_boundary: stateful in-memory test doubles; no AWS requests
measurement.network: socket.connect and socket.connect_ex blocked during benchmark execution
measurement.resource_mix: even round-robin across EC2, S3, RDS, and Lambda
measurement.warmup: one untimed event for each resource type
measurement.latency: time.perf_counter_ns around each handler invocation; includes handler and mock calls
measurement.throughput: events divided by elapsed wall-clock time for the timed handler loop
measurement.measurement_excludes: event generation, mock seeding, and post-run functional assertions
measurement.limitations: local Python plus in-memory mock overhead; not AWS service latency or production capacity
